attchmntText: A2Z Infra Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: A2Z Infra Engineering Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The company incurred a net loss after tax of Rs. 25.06 lakhs. Accumulated losses stand at Rs. 1,07,684.84 lakhs. Current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 5,973.91 lakhs. The company faces acute liquidity problems. Borrowings classified as non-performing assets carry unpaid interest of Rs. 56.96 lakhs for the quarter. Statutory auditors issued a disclaimer of conclusion. They could not obtain sufficient evidence regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern. Disputes with sugar mills and proceedings in Chhattisgarh remain pending. Financial results for branches in Tanzania, Nepal, and Uganda were not reviewed by the auditors.
